posts.hook: The biggest crypto theft ever began with a Google ad
posts.caption: binance says the $6.3b theft began with a tampered installer from a malicious ad, canva cuts 22% of staff, russia looks to move data centers underground. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Binance says the $6.3B theft started with a tampered installer from a malicious ad
slides.desc: A fake job interview in September came later; the first foothold was an ad-delivered download in June.

slides.title: Google backs down: schools can now switch Gemini, Notebook and Search on separately
slides.desc: A day after tying Search to its AI features, backlash ended the all-or-nothing rule.

slides.title: Russia wants its data centers underground after Ukrainian drone strikes
slides.desc: Yandex and Sberbank sites were hit; the Kremlin now requires capacity reserved for the state.

slides.title: Canva cuts or changes roles for ==22%== of its staff to "refound" itself
slides.desc: 1,271 people affected as product, growth and platform teams merge.

slides.title: Revolut says self-hosted models cut its AI coding costs by about 90%
slides.desc: Its own figure: GLM models became the default over commercial tools like Claude Code.

terms.gloss: open-weight language models you can run on your own servers

posts.hook: Election night turned the AI buildout into a campaign issue
posts.caption: voters pushed back on data centers at the ballot box, openai is buying pierre to deepen codex, uber says ai agents booked four rides last quarter. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Data centers lost the midterms: ==76%== of polled voters opposed them nearby
slides.desc: Dozens of localities restricted them, and CoreWeave's bonds fell after the sweep.

slides.title: OpenAI is buying Pierre to give Codex better tools for reviewing code
slides.desc: One report frames it as a move at Microsoft's GitHub.

slides.title: Uber says AI agents arranged only ==4== rides last quarter
slides.desc: About 500 Eats orders in Halloween week, out of 320 million trips and deliveries.

slides.title: Moonshot opens the Kimi K3.1 Pro weights, claiming a win on coding agents
slides.desc: The benchmark claim is Moonshot's own; the open weights can be tested by anyone.

terms.gloss: the trained model files anyone can download and run

slides.title: A PHP bug was known to maintainers two years before the php2shell attacks
slides.desc: A chained exploit is now hitting servers, per the post-mortem.

terms.gloss: a scripting language behind much of the web

slides.title: Sequoia raised about $10B, then shut Arc and Scouts and closed its London office
slides.desc: Early-stage and growth teams merge as the firm pulls back to the Bay Area.
